$schema-note: Defines one complete site style. The file supplies two color palettes, four font roles, shape, texture, density, a default illustration set, and curated options.
$palette-note: Color channels use [r, g, b] numbers. The generator writes RGB triples. The dark palette is authored separately.
$first-class-note: All six styles are complete and supported. Each has one default configuration.
label: Newsroom
summary: A modern editorial layout with strong section rules, compact data, and restrained color.
bestFor: Use this style for publications, media conferences, and newsroom events.
$palette-words-light: cool newsprint white, desk black, one saturated editorial accent, muted data slate, hairline silver, section-rule graphite, caption grey, archive fog
$palette-words-dark: charcoal desk, screen-lit soft white, night-retuned editorial accent, dimmed data slate, graphite rule, ash grey, low-lamp caption grey, archive slate
$font-note: Uses Fraunces for headings, Newsreader for body text, Plex Sans for labels and data, and Plex Mono for figures and identifiers.
$tokens-note: Remaps existing tier 2 and tier 3 tokens. The style uses the data font for folio text and a strong rule below each section heading. The definition list keeps the data face for its terms in a wide column. The pull quote sits between strong rules with a large opening mark. An urgent notice takes the nameplate rule, and table heads are set in small capitals over a strong rule. The standfirst is set in the heading typeface at regular weight.

choices.label: Fraunces
choices.why: Uses a distinctive soft-serif heading face. It separates headlines from Newsreader body text and Plex data text.

choices.label: Newsreader at display weights
choices.why: Uses Newsreader for both headings and body text. This creates a quieter and more traditional publication style.

choices.label: Archivo bold condensed
choices.why: Uses condensed sans-serif headlines. It fits longer titles in less vertical space and increases visual contrast.

choices.label: Rule-bounded bar
choices.why: Places the event name at the left and dates at the right. A strong rule closes the header.

choices.label: Stacked with a deck
choices.why: Places the event name above a short factual description. A hairline rule closes the header.

choices.label: Section-aware bar
choices.why: Uses a smaller running header for inner pages and keeps the active section visible.

choices.label: Hairline row
choices.why: Uses one row for the title, time, track, and speaker. Hairline rules separate the rows.

choices.label: Lead and rest
choices.why: Makes the first session larger than the remaining sessions. Use it when one session must lead the list.

longReadOpening.label: Long read opening
longReadOpening.prompt: Choose how the first paragraph of a Long read page opens.

choices.label: Drop cap
choices.why: Enlarges the first letter of the first paragraph to the height of three lines, in the heading typeface.

choices.label: Standfirst
choices.why: Sets the first paragraph at the lead size, as a summary of the page.

choices.label: Plain
choices.why: Keeps the first paragraph at body size with no drop cap.

quote.label: Quote device
quote.prompt: Choose how a quoted sentence is set.

choices.label: Ruled with an opening mark
choices.why: Sets the quote between strong rules with a large opening mark in the heading typeface.

choices.label: Side rule
choices.why: Sets the quote beside one strong rule with no rules above or below and no mark.

choices.label: Opening mark only
choices.why: Sets the quote with the large opening mark and no rules.

directory.label: Directory style
directory.prompt: Choose how the speaker shelf and the attendee index are set.

choices.label: Portrait shelf
choices.why: Sets square portraits on the alternate ground, ruled at the hairline.

choices.label: Tall portraits
choices.why: Sets portraits at three by four, like a profile picture in a print feature.

sectionBoundary.label: Section boundary
sectionBoundary.prompt: Choose how a section heading is ruled and labelled.

choices.label: Rule and folio
choices.why: Draws the section rule with the folio at the far end of the heading line.

choices.label: Rule only
choices.why: Draws the section rule and hides the folio beside the heading.

choices.label: Folio in the margin
choices.why: Places the folio where the margin column opens beside the text measure on wide screens. On narrow screens it returns to the end of the line.

tableRules.label: Table rules
tableRules.prompt: Choose how a table is ruled.

choices.label: Hairline rows
choices.why: Rules the rows and the head at the hairline and draws no column rules.

choices.label: Ruled head
choices.why: Closes the head with a strong rule and rules the rows at the hairline, with no column rules.

choices.label: Full grid
choices.why: Rules the rows and the columns at the hairline, with the head closed at the width the style sets.
